privacy.breach.body: If personal data is exposed, we will act at once and inform the people affected and the Data Protection Board as the law requires.
privacy.breach.title: If something goes wrong
privacy.children.body: AdvocateID is for advocates and for people looking for advocates. We do not track or target anyone under 18.
privacy.children.title: Children
privacy.collect.body: Account holders: mobile number, the details they put on their pages (name, photo, enrolment number, address, contact numbers) and their consents. Visitors: a random daily visitor code, the page viewed and the date, with no name, mobile number or full IP address.
privacy.collect.title: What we collect
privacy.consent.body: We ask for your consent before collecting your mobile number and again before showing a different contact number. You can withdraw consent at any time by deleting your account.
privacy.consent.title: Consent
privacy.cookies.body: We use only essential cookies: your login, saved pages, compare list, your language and a random visitor code that changes every day. There is no advertising or cross-site tracking.
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies
privacy.intro: This notice explains what personal data AdvocateID collects, why, for how long, and your rights under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.processors.body: We use these service providers. Counsel will confirm the final list.
privacy.processors.title: Who processes data for us
privacy.purpose.body: To log you in with an OTP, to publish the pages you create, to let visitors contact the pages they choose, to protect the service from abuse, and to count views so that the directory can be improved. We do not use your data for anything else without asking you again.
privacy.purpose.title: Why we collect it
privacy.retention.body: Each type of data has a fixed period, after which it is deleted automatically:
privacy.retention.events: Visit records: 30 days in detail, then daily totals for one year.
privacy.retention.grievances: Grievances: 3 years after they are resolved.
privacy.retention.mobile: Mobile number and account: while your account exists, and 30 days after you ask us to delete it.
privacy.retention.pages: Pages and pictures: while the page exists, and 30 days after it is deleted.
privacy.retention.title: How long we keep data
privacy.rights.body: You can download your data from your account settings, correct it in the page editor, delete your account, and write to the grievance officer at any time.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.security.body: Data is sent over HTTPS. OTPs and sessions are stored only as one-way hashes. Admin actions are logged. Access is limited to what is needed.
privacy.security.title: Security
privacy.title: Privacy notice
terms.bar.body: Advocates may not solicit work or advertise under the Bar Council of India Rules. Pages may show only permitted information. Wording that promotes or compares is not allowed and may be removed.
terms.bar.title: Bar Council rules
terms.changes.body: We may update these terms. The date of the latest version will be shown here.
terms.changes.title: Changes
terms.content.body: Pages are written by the advocates and firms themselves. They are responsible for the accuracy and legality of what they publish. Unlawful content is not allowed.
terms.content.title: Content on pages
terms.liability.body: Information is declared by pages and is not verified by AdvocateID. Nothing here is legal advice.
terms.liability.title: No guarantee
terms.reports.body: Anyone can report a page, post or update. We may suspend or remove content, or recall a page address, with or without notice.
terms.reports.title: Reports and removal
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.use.body: AdvocateID is a directory. Using it does not create a relationship between you and any advocate or firm listed.
terms.use.title: Using the directory
